query: select count(distinct "segments"."episode_id") from "segments" inner join "episodes" on "segments"."episode_id" = "episodes"."id" inner join "shows" on "episodes"."show_id" = "shows"."id" where "shows"."slug" not in (?, ?)

select count(distinct "claims"."episode_id"), count(distinct case when "claims"."attribution_status" = 'verified_speaker' then "claims"."person_id" end), count(*) from "claims" inner join "episodes" on "claims"."episode_id" = "episodes"."id" inner join "shows" on "episodes"."show_id" = "shows"."id" where ("claims"."review_status" = ? and "shows"."slug" not in (?, ?))

select "claims"."assertion", "claims"."attribution_status", "claims"."id", case when "episodes"."transcript_kind" = 'youtube_captions' then "claim_evidence"."deep_link_url" else null end, "episodes"."title", "claim_references"."kind", "claim_references"."name", case when "claims"."attribution_status" = 'verified_speaker' then "claims"."person_id" else null end, case when "claims"."attribution_status" = 'verified_speaker' then "people"."name" else null end, "claims"."quote", "claim_references"."role", "claims"."said_on", "claims"."prompt_version", "claims"."segment_id", "shows"."name", "episodes"."source_url", case when "episodes"."transcript_kind" = 'youtube_captions' then "claims"."timestamp_s" else null end, "episodes"."transcript_kind" from "claim_references" inner join "claims" on "claim_references"."claim_id" = "claims"."id" inner join "episodes" on "claims"."episode_id" = "episodes"."id" inner join "shows" on "episodes"."show_id" = "shows"."id" inner join "people" on "claims"."person_id" = "people"."id" inner join "claim_evidence" on ("claim_evidence"."claim_id" = "claims"."id" and "claim_evidence"."role" = ?) where ("claims"."review_status" = ? and "claim_references"."role" in (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) and "shows"."slug" not in (?, ?)) order by "claims"."said_on" desc, "claims"."created_at" asc, "claim_references"."id" asc limit ?

select "claims"."assertion", "claims"."attribution_status", "claims"."claim_type", (
    case when "episodes"."transcript_kind" = 'youtube_captions' then (
      select "claim_evidence"."deep_link_url"
      from "claim_evidence"
      where "claim_evidence"."claim_id" = "claims"."id"
        and "claim_evidence"."role" = 'primary'
      limit ?
    ) else null end
  ), "episodes"."id", "episodes"."title", "claims"."id", case when "claims"."attribution_status" = 'verified_speaker' then "people"."id" else null end, case when "claims"."attribution_status" = 'verified_speaker' then "people"."name" else null end, case when "claims"."attribution_status" = 'verified_speaker' then "people"."org" else null end, case when "claims"."attribution_status" = 'verified_speaker' then "people"."slug" else null end, case when "claims"."attribution_status" = 'verified_speaker' then "people"."title" else null end, "claims"."quote", "claims"."review_status", "claims"."said_on", "shows"."name", "shows"."slug", "episodes"."source_url", "claims"."stance", case when "episodes"."transcript_kind" = 'youtube_captions' then "claims"."timestamp_s" else null end, "episodes"."transcript_kind" from "claims" inner join "people" on "claims"."person_id" = "people"."id" inner join "episodes" on "claims"."episode_id" = "episodes"."id" inner join "shows" on "episodes"."show_id" = "shows"."id" where ("claims"."review_status" = ? and "people"."status" = ? and "shows"."slug" not in (?, ?)) order by "claims"."said_on" desc, "claims"."created_at" desc limit ?

select "people"."bio", count(distinct "claims"."id"), "people"."id", "people"."links", "people"."name", "people"."org", "people"."slug", count(distinct "claims"."episode_id"), "people"."status", "people"."title" from "people" inner join "claims" on "people"."id" = "claims"."person_id" inner join "episodes" on "claims"."episode_id" = "episodes"."id" inner join "shows" on "episodes"."show_id" = "shows"."id" where ("people"."status" = ? and "claims"."review_status" = ? and "claims"."attribution_status" = ? and "shows"."slug" not in (?, ?)) group by "people"."id" order by count(distinct "claims"."id") desc, "people"."name" limit ?

select count(distinct "claims"."episode_id") from "claims" inner join "episodes" on "claims"."episode_id" = "episodes"."id" inner join "shows" on "episodes"."show_id" = "shows"."id" where ("claims"."review_status" = ? and "shows"."slug" not in (?, ?))

select count(distinct "claims"."id"), count(distinct case when "claims"."attribution_status" = 'verified_speaker' then "claims"."person_id" end), "episodes"."duration_s", "episodes"."id", "episodes"."published_at", "shows"."name", "shows"."slug", "episodes"."source_url", "episodes"."status", "episodes"."title", "episodes"."transcript_kind" from "episodes" inner join "shows" on "episodes"."show_id" = "shows"."id" inner join "claims" on "episodes"."id" = "claims"."episode_id" where ("claims"."review_status" = ? and "shows"."slug" not in (?, ?)) group by "episodes"."id" order by "episodes"."published_at" desc limit ?

select count(distinct "people"."id") from "people" inner join "claims" on "people"."id" = "claims"."person_id" inner join "episodes" on "claims"."episode_id" = "episodes"."id" inner join "shows" on "episodes"."show_id" = "shows"."id" where ("people"."status" = ? and "claims"."review_status" = ? and "claims"."attribution_status" = ? and "shows"."slug" not in (?, ?))

select count(distinct "episodes"."id"), count(distinct "shows"."id") from "episodes" inner join "shows" on "episodes"."show_id" = "shows"."id" where ("shows"."active" = ? and "shows"."slug" not in (?, ?))

select "audio_url", "created_at", "description", "duration_s", "guid", "id", "pipeline_version", "published_at", "raw_hash", "raw_r2_key", "show_id", "source_url", "status", "status_detail", "title", "transcript_kind", "updated_at", "youtube_video_id" from "episodes" where "episodes"."status" = ? order by "episodes"."published_at" desc limit ? offset ?
